notes: Six own pages read (home, pricing, about, the law practice management product page, the accounting product page, and the cited Rocket Matter comparison URL, which redirected to the /compare/ hub with no prices), all HTTP 200 and not thin; six cited pages read for causes, all HTTP 200 (12 of 14 page budget used). In pass 2 the pricing page was also read once in a real browser; its main text carries the add-ons, built-into-every-plan features and FAQ but no plan table or prices, so C04 (whether $49/$99/$129 are annual rates) stays unverifiable; for the reviewer only, the raw HTML carries JSON-LD giving $49/$99/$129 billed yearly and $59/$109/$139 billed monthly, which was not used to class. The ChatGPT answers captured 22 to 23 Sep cite the pricing page with the same Launch $49, Core $99, Pro $129 list, so the price list stood on the capture date. The wrong starting-price claims (C05 to C13) are wrong under either reading of the toggle, because Launch at $49 with a $120 yearly saving caps the starting price at $49 yearly and $59 monthly; C09 and C10 quote figures that fit the Core plan, not the starting plan. C17 and C18 rely on the plan table's unavailable marks, which the page labels Not included in Launch and Not included in Core for General Ledger & Payables and Bank feeds. C14 (custom or on-request pricing) stays wrong against the published price list; the home FAQ says to request a quote or view pricing on the site, which a reviewer may weigh. Only one cause was found (referent.law for the $89 start); counselstack.io (read under 8am-mycase, cited by the q4 Claude answers) gives CosmoLex $109 and $129, not $89, and itqlick gives $89 but is cited only by answers carrying the $89 to $119 and $109 to $119 ranges, so those were recorded as cause not found. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no class changed; the consistency check kept all eleven wrong claims (C05 to C14, C18) as explicit, like-with-like contradictions on the pricing page; the gap lines (accounting feature descriptions, opinions, and $89 cells already counted at record level) and the tables and vendor sub-headings added no claim or instance. Not coded: accounting capability descriptions (built-in general ledger, no QuickBooks needed), ratings and review counts, the April 2025 workflow launch, attributed source summaries in q8 Perplexity ('About $79 to $109 in some listings', 'Reported as ... across comparison sources'), 'Varies' price cells, and the Tabs3 by ProfitSolv sections (another product).
